Pages = 2n, so 2n ≡ 3 (mod 7). Pages must be even and ≡ 3 mod 7, so pages ≡ 10 mod 14. That gives n ≡ 5 (mod 7). The smallest n > 100 with n ≡ 5 (mod 7): 98 + 5 = 103, which is > 100.

Check: 2·103 = 206 = 7·29 + 3. ✓.

Solution A claims n = 7 works, but 14 ≡ 0 (mod 7), not 3, so it is wrong. Its answer of 112 gives 224 ≡ 0 (mod 7), which fails.

Solution B gets 103, which is correct (pages 206 is even, so leaves are an integer).

WINNER: B
